title: Read-only saved 100-item CUET readiness campaign cost comparison
database_access: SQLite opened readOnly:true under a read transaction; no ledger writes or provider calls.

conditional_marginal_10000.method: Completed-arm gross committed spend (settled actuals plus maximum reserved amounts for unsettled holds) divided by terminal machine-eligible count, multiplied by 10,000.
conditional_marginal_10000.status: Conditional upper bound from this observed completed cohort only; not a settled invoice, guarantee, or approved spend. Holds are included at their committed maximum; reasoning tokens are already inside output-token usage and are not billed twice.

arms.execution_mode_source: persisted request config when present; receipt-only requests with missing mode are isolated as unknown, never inferred

repair_summary.remaining_validation_rechecks_not_classi: Requests on non-repair stages may include revalidation after a repair; no initial-versus-revalidation split is asserted without persisted attempt identifiers.

composition.semantic_uniqueness_note: Exact normalized fingerprints are deterministic text/option/key checks; they do not establish semantic uniqueness.

request_attribution.identity_basis: Exact preregistered campaign IDs matched against persisted native request config candidate_id and parsed provider-body identity when available, with receipt candidate_id cross-check; reservation IDs deduplicated.
request_attribution.missing_execution_mode_handling: Receipt-only rows lacking a stored mode are explicitly placed in unknown_receipt_only; no mode is inferred from provider errors.

arms.execution_mode_source: persisted request config when present; receipt-only requests with missing mode are isolated as unknown, never inferred

repair_summary.remaining_validation_rechecks_not_classi: Requests on non-repair stages may include revalidation after a repair; no initial-versus-revalidation split is asserted without persisted attempt identifiers.

composition.semantic_uniqueness_note: Exact normalized fingerprints are deterministic text/option/key checks; they do not establish semantic uniqueness.

request_attribution.identity_basis: Exact preregistered campaign IDs matched against persisted native request config candidate_id and parsed provider-body identity when available, with receipt candidate_id cross-check; reservation IDs deduplicated.

limitations: A/B comparison is descriptive until both fixed 100-item denominators are terminal and their exact request/receipt totals reconcile.
Machine eligibility is not ground truth or CUET release evidence.
Per-item exact fingerprint hashes do not establish semantic uniqueness.
Post-repair validations are not classified as initial without explicit persisted attempt identifiers.
Provider usage receipts and bounded holds are not invoices.
